parties.note: Flemish Christian democrats under their name from 29 September 2001 (the Dutch Wikipedia says only 'end of September 2001'). Chair dates follow the Dutch Wikipedia list: it gives Leterme until 22 July 2004 but Vandeurzen (acting until his election on 29 October 2004) from 16 June 2004; the handover is recorded as 16 June. The interim co-chairs Cindy Franssen and Griet Smaers (8 October - 6 December 2019) are omitted. Wikidata dates Beke's second term from 22 December 2010, the day he was formally elected. Ran in a joint list (cartel) with the N-VA in 2007. Red line: the cordon sanitaire against the Vlaams Blok and its successor.

Karel De Gucht was acting chair from 12 July 1999 and elected on 20 November 1999; Dirk Sterckx performed his duties from 15 February to 13 June 2004. Bart Somers was acting from 19 July 2004 and elected on 4 December 2004. In February 2007 the VLD and Vivant ended their cartel and stood as Open Vld. Red line: the cordon sanitaire against the Vlaams Blok and its successor.

parties.note: Flemish greens; in the Verhofstadt I government 1999-2003. Agalev had no chair; its leading post was political secretary. Jos Geysels held it from 8 June 1998 (acting until 23 October 1999) to 21 June 2003; Dirk Holemans (21 June - 15 November 2003) is omitted. Lost all its Chamber seats in 2003 and was renamed Groen! on 15 November 2003. Red line: the cordon sanitaire against the Vlaams Blok.

parties.note: Francophone greens, led by a federal secretariat (two co-presidents since 2007). In the Verhofstadt I government 1999-2003. Leaders named in the federal election infoboxes: Philippe Defeyt, Évelyne Huytebroeck and Marc Hordies (2003), Jean-Michel Javaux and Isabelle Durant (2007), Javaux and Sarah Turine (2010), Olivier Deleuze and Emily Hoyos (2014), Jean-Marc Nollet and Zakia Khattabi (2019), Rajae Maouane and Nollet (2024; they resigned in June 2024). The French Wikipedia gives Samuel Cogolati and Marie Lecocq as co-presidents elected on 13 July 2024 and Marie-Colline Leroy and Gilles Vanden Burre from 15 March 2026; the English infobox instead names Vanden Burre and Cogolati.
